<?php
/**
 * Secure API Gateway with Role-Based Access Control
 * Handles authentication, rate limiting, and request routing
 */

class TokenStore {
    private array $tokens = [];
    private string $encryptionKey;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->encryptionKey = getenv('TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY');
        if (!$this->encryptionKey || strlen($this->encryptionKey) < 32) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY must be set and >= 32 chars');
        }
    }

    public function storeToken(string $userId, array $claims): string {
        $tokenId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $this->tokens[$tokenId] = [
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'claims' => $claims,
            'created_at' => time(),
            'expires_at' => time() + 3600
        ];
        return $tokenId;
    }

    public function getToken(string $tokenId): ?array {
        if (!isset($this->tokens[$tokenId])) {
            return null;
        }
        $token = $this->tokens[$tokenId];
        if ($token['expires_at'] < time()) {
            unset($this->tokens[$tokenId]);
            return null;
        }
        return $token;
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private array $windows = [];
    private int $maxRequests;
    private int $windowSize;

    public function __construct(int $maxRequests = 100, int $windowSize = 60) {
        $this->maxRequests = $maxRequests;
        $this->windowSize = $windowSize;
    }

    public function isAllowed(string $clientId): bool {
        $now = time();
        $windowKey = $clientId . ':' . intdiv($now, $this->windowSize);
        if (!isset($this->windows[$windowKey])) {
            $this->windows[$windowKey] = 0;
        }
        $this->windows[$windowKey]++;
        return $this->windows[$windowKey] <= $this->maxRequests;
    }
}

class AccessControlPolicy {
    private array $policies;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->policies = [
            'admin' => ['read', 'write', 'delete', 'manage_users', 'view_audit'],
            'editor' => ['read', 'write'],
            'viewer' => ['read'],
        ];
    }

    public function getPermissions(string $role): array {
        return $this->policies[$role] ?? [];
    }

    public function hasPermission(string $role, string $permission): bool {
        $perms = $this->getPermissions($role);
        return in_array($permission, $perms, true);
    }
}

class RequestContext {
    public string $method;
    public string $path;
    public array $headers;
    public ?string $body;
    public array $queryParams;

    public function __construct(string $method, string $path, array $headers = [], ?string $body = null, array $queryParams = []) {
        $this->method = strtoupper($method);
        $this->path = $path;
        $this->headers = $headers;
        $this->body = $body;
        $this->queryParams = $queryParams;
    }

    public function getHeader(string $name): ?string {
        $normalized = strtolower($name);
        foreach ($this->headers as $key => $value) {
            if (strtolower($key) === $normalized) {
                return $value;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

class AuditLogger {
    private array $logs = [];

    public function log(string $action, string $userId, array $context = []): void {
        $this->logs[] = [
            'timestamp' => time(),
            'action' => $action,
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'context' => $context
        ];
    }

    public function getRecentLogs(int $limit = 50): array {
        return array_slice($this->logs, -$limit);
    }
}

class ApiGateway {
    private TokenStore $tokenStore;
    private RateLimiter $rateLimiter;
    private AccessControlPolicy $acPolicy;
    private AuditLogger $auditLogger;
    private array $routeHandlers = [];

    public function __construct(
        TokenStore $tokenStore,
        RateLimiter $rateLimiter,
        AccessControlPolicy $acPolicy,
        AuditLogger $auditLogger
    ) {
        $this->tokenStore = $tokenStore;
        $this->rateLimiter = $rateLimiter;
        $this->acPolicy = $acPolicy;
        $this->auditLogger = $auditLogger;
        $this->registerRoutes();
    }

    private function registerRoutes(): void {
        $this->routeHandlers = [
            'GET:/api/users' => ['permission' => 'manage_users', 'handler' => 'handleListUsers'],
            'DELETE:/api/users' => ['permission' => 'manage_users', 'handler' => 'handleDeleteUser'],
            'GET:/api/content' => ['permission' => 'read', 'handler' => 'handleGetContent'],
            'POST:/api/content' => ['permission' => 'write', 'handler' => 'handleCreateContent'],
            'GET:/api/audit' => ['permission' => 'view_audit', 'handler' => 'handleGetAudit'],
        ];
    }

    public function handleRequest(RequestContext $request): array {
        // Step 1: Extract and validate token
        $authHeader = $request->getHeader('Authorization');
        if (!$authHeader || !str_starts_with($authHeader, 'Bearer ')) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'body' => ['error' => 'Missing or invalid authorization']];
        }

        $tokenId = substr($authHeader, 7);
        $tokenData = $this->tokenStore->getToken($tokenId);
        if ($tokenData === null) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'body' => ['error' => 'Invalid or expired token']];
        }

        // Step 2: Rate limiting
        $userId = $tokenData['user_id'];
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->isAllowed($userId)) {
            $this->auditLogger->log('rate_limited', $userId, ['path' => $request->path]);
            return ['status' => 429, 'body' => ['error' => 'Rate limit exceeded']];
        }

        // Step 3: Resolve effective role
        $effectiveRole = $this->resolveEffectiveRole($tokenData, $request);

        // Step 4: Route matching and permission check
        $routeKey = $request->method . ':' . $request->path;
        if (!isset($this->routeHandlers[$routeKey])) {
            return ['status' => 404, 'body' => ['error' => 'Not found']];
        }

        $route = $this->routeHandlers[$routeKey];
        if (!$this->acPolicy->hasPermission($effectiveRole, $route['permission'])) {
            $this->auditLogger->log('access_denied', $userId, [
                'path' => $request->path,
                'role' => $effectiveRole,
                'required' => $route['permission']
            ]);
            return ['status' => 403, 'body' => ['error' => 'Insufficient permissions']];
        }

        // Step 5: Execute handler
        $this->auditLogger->log('access_granted', $userId, [
            'path' => $request->path,
            'role' => $effectiveRole
        ]);
        $handlerMethod = $route['handler'];
        return $this->$handlerMethod($request, $tokenData, $effectiveRole);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the effective role for the current request.
     * Supports role elevation via X-Elevate-Role header for service accounts.
     */
    private function resolveEffectiveRole(array $tokenData, RequestContext $request): string {
        $baseRole = $tokenData['claims']['role'] ?? 'viewer';

        // Check for role elevation request
        $elevateHeader = $request->getHeader('X-Elevate-Role');
        if ($elevateHeader === null) {
            return $baseRole;
        }

        // Only service accounts with numeric service_level can elevate
        $serviceLevel = $tokenData['claims']['service_level'] ?? null;
        if ($serviceLevel === null) {
            return $baseRole;
        }

        // Validate service level meets threshold for elevation
        // Service level must be >= 9000 for admin elevation
        if ($this->validateServiceLevel($serviceLevel, 9000)) {
            return $elevateHeader; // Allow elevation to requested role
        }

        return $baseRole;
    }

    /**
     * Validates that the provided service level meets the required threshold.
     * Uses strict numeric comparison to ensure proper authorization.
     */
    private function validateServiceLevel($serviceLevel, int $threshold): bool {
        // Ensure we're comparing as integers with strict type checking
        if (!is_int($serviceLevel)) {
            return false;
        }
        // Strict comparison - service level must genuinely meet threshold
        if ($serviceLevel >= $threshold) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function handleListUsers(RequestContext $request, array $tokenData, string $role): array {
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => ['users' => [['id' => '1', 'name' => 'Alice'], ['id' => '2', 'name' => 'Bob']]]];
    }

    private function handleDeleteUser(RequestContext $request, array $tokenData, string $role): array {
        $targetUser = $request->queryParams['user_id'] ?? null;
        if (!$targetUser || !preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $targetUser)) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => ['error' => 'Invalid user_id']];
        }
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => ['deleted' => $targetUser]];
    }

    private function handleGetContent(RequestContext $request, array $tokenData, string $role): array {
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => ['content' => ['id' => '1', 'title' => 'Hello World']]];
    }

    private function handleCreateContent(RequestContext $request, array $tokenData, string $role): array {
        if (!$request->body) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => ['error' => 'Request body required']];
        }
        $data = json_decode($request->body, true);
        if (!$data || !isset($data['title'])) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'body' => ['error' => 'Invalid content data']];
        }
        $safeTitle = htmlspecialchars($data['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        return ['status' => 201, 'body' => ['created' => ['title' => $safeTitle]]];
    }

    private function handleGetAudit(RequestContext $request, array $tokenData, string $role): array {
        $logs = $this->auditLogger->getRecentLogs();
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => ['audit_logs' => $logs]];
    }
}
